blocks.text: Stop looking at stock tickers. Start x-raying businesses. // INITIATE DEEP SCAN PROTOCOL
Before you check the price, check the pulse. Does this business actually make sense in the real world?
Is it Colgate (Daily Habit) or Fidget Spinner (Short Trend)?
If they raise price by ₹5, will you switch? If NO, they have power (Maggi).
To sell 2x more, do they need 2x more factories (Steel) or just a click (Software)?
Does one change in Govt policy kill them? (e.g., Alcohol/Gaming bans).
How hard is it to kill this company? We visualize this using a Radar Chart.
Brand Power • Switching Cost • Network Effect
Price is what you pay. Value is what you get. Use the slider to understand P/E Ratio (Price to Earnings).
The Logic: If P/E is 20, you are paying ₹20 to earn ₹1 of company profit. If P/E is 80, you are paying ₹80 for that same ₹1. Be careful.
Numbers can be faked. Character cannot. How to spot a thief?
